newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent quiet, NYMEX steady, seeking direction.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent quiet, NYMEX steady, seeking direction.

text.p: Brent crude futures were scarcely talked at midday in Asia on Friday after overnight markets failed to find direction.
August Brent was untraded and bid at $17.66 per barrel, after London settled at $17.78, for a gain of just one cent on the day.
NYMEX crude on ACCESS was steady with August up four cents at $18.96 compared with New York's close at $18.67 for a loss on the day of 12 cents.
Both London and New York rose during trading on Thursday but by the close gave up the gains.
Brokers said SIMEX was likely to take a back seat until London and New York established a direction for the market.
They said some players might look to lock in profits on short positions ahead of the weekend and the start of the mid-year ministerial OPEC meeting in Vienna.
OPEC starts its meeting on Wednesday but ministers will arrive a few days before.
Traders have said they expect a roll over of OPEC's 25.033 million barrels-per-day supply ceiling and that the key issue will be how to curb quota violations.
